purpose: Words whose syllables or stress the general rules in scripts/lib/latin-phonology.cjs would get wrong. Each entry gives the analysis explicitly, the evidence and a status. form is the macron-free lowercase spelling.

words.note: Trisyllabic Gāĭus, as L&S marks it (Catullus 10.30). Some teaching texts treat it as Gāj-jus, like māior. The TTS prompt 'GAH-yoos' is disyllabic. See LATIN_UNRESOLVED.md U-05. The earlier IPA draft (docs/audio/latin-ipa-pilot-lexicon.json) has the disyllabic ˈɡaː.jʊs.
words.source: Lewis & Short s.v. Gāĭus; A&G §11.d Note

words.note: ui is a diphthong in cui (one syllable).
Two syllables by synizesis, not de-in-de.
